text.p: Koger Equity Inc said on Friday that it will pay a $0.05 dividend February 10, 1997, to shareholders of record on January 6, 1997.
The last time the company paid a dividend was in 1991.
In a press release, Koger said that it will generate about $32 million, or $1.73 per share, in funds from operations in 1996.
It said that due to the tax loss carryforwards (NOLs), its 1996 REIT taxable income was fully sheltered so that it was not required to pay a dividend in 1996 in order to maintain its REIT status.
In 1997, Koger Equity will continue to have NOLs available of which $16.3 million may be used to reduce its 1997 REIT taxable income, enabling it to retain more of its internally generated cash.
